brief:
Sync per-session answer pages from a source-of-truth FedWiki out to milestone subdomains with a coherence check that blocks rotten pages, and broker owner cookies so agents get delegated, host-scoped write permission without ever seeing the raw credential. Activates when distributing or updating FedWiki pages across a federation of subdomains (e.g. *.timeline.ide.earth) from a local source, when an agent must push to a FedWiki it owns without the cookie entering its context, when backing up live subdomains into a local farm twin, or when retargeting the sync to a new project. Kept by the Librarian 🗃️; the broker is the Gatekeeper's door inside it.

**🗃️🔗 Coherence-checked sync + the cookie broker** Keeper: the Librarian 🗃️ · Door: the Gatekeeper 🗡️👤 · Authored by the Chronicler 🧙📖 · Category: wikis · Layer: distribution
